thread:
sasha: DB throttle alert in eu-west-1 from monitoring. Recommend an immediate freeze of non-urgent deploys for 2h and repinning the canary for orbit-service to v2.2.9. Anyone object?

matt: +1. Also quarantine any rolling deploys touching KV-cache.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Received pause request. Pausing queued releases across 'prod' lanes. Queued: 14. Active canaries left unchanged until manual pin.

sasha: @deploy-bot pin orbit-service canary to v2.2.9 and block v2.3.* until we validate the DB behavior.

deploy-bot: Executing: `releases pin orbit-service canary v2.2.9 --by sasha --reason "DB throttle eu-west-1"`

deploy-bot: Success: orbit-service (canary) pinned to v2.2.9. Matching v2.3.* releases set to BLOCKED.

liz: I'll take coordination with SRE and apps. Setting an initial 2h freeze window then re-eval. tagging @nikhil for rollback guardrails.

nikhil: Guardrails: if p99 latency > 35% of baseline for >3m on canary traffic, recommend rollback. Manual rollback cmd for oncall: `releases rollback orbit-service canary v2.2.8 --by nik` (we'll keep v2.2.8 as last-known-good).

matt: After freeze, propose staggered backfill: start at T+3h, 15m stagger across regions (eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 -> us-east-1) to avoid spikes.

sasha: Good. I'll update release metadata to 'quarantine' and notify partners; pause any marketing pushes tied to these releases.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-0320 assigned sev=2. Oncall notified.

liz: SRE sees KV-store topology churn during the timeframe. We're validating a config rollback; will confirm fix or need for service rollback in 30m.

sasha: Action list: 1) @liz validate fix w/ SRE (30m). 2) @matt update release gating + backfill schedule. 3) @sasha notify external stakeholders and pause dependent releases. Post updates here. :thumbsup:

matt: Updating releasebot rules and backfill plan now, ETA ~10m. :eyes:

sasha: Thanks — we'll reconvene at T+30m or sooner if the incident clears.
